ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Augmont Enterprises Limited has disclosed that the spouse of a Non-Executive Director, Mr. Amitkumar Amritlal Solanki, purchased 2,115 equity shares (representing 0.00% of total paid-up share capital) through on-market transactions during September 2026, totaling approximately INR 20.87 lakhs. This is a routine compliance disclosure under SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015, and indicates adherence to regulatory transparency requirements. The transaction represents a minor personal investment by an immediate relative of an insider and does not present any material financial impact or regulatory red flags for the company.
